title: Rapid Align: Week Zero - Compact All-Hands & Exec Brief
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, low-bandwidth playbook for Week Zero: the 3-week alignment window before Q2 sprinting. Target audience: execs, GTM leads, eng/product managers who will present at or contribute materials to the company all-hands.

TL;DR (for execs who want one page):
- Goal: align org on 3 company-level OKRs, communicate top-3 cross-functional bets, and run a 60-minute all-hands that sends clear team-level next steps.
- Timebox: week of Mar 9-13 is Week Zero (final pre-read + exec dry runs). All-hands: Mar 16, 60m.
- Owner: Maya Chen (exec ops). Key partners: Product (Priya), Eng (Diego), SRE (Owen), Growth (Lena).
- Asks: execs provide 2-slide mini-deck by Mar 6; PMs submit team sprint commitments by Mar 10.

Top-level proposed company OKRs (drafts - simplified):
- OKR 1: Predictable inference at scale
  - KR1.1: Reduce median API p99 latency for text-generation by 15% on hosted tier (baseline: 320ms)
  - KR1.2: Decrease per-1M-token cost for common web workloads by 20% via batching + cache recommendations
  - KR1.3: Launch Dedicated autoscaling beta with 3 pilot customers onboarded

- OKR 2: Product-led adoption and activation
  - KR2.1: Increase API DAU by 25% (organic self-serve signups -> active callbacks)
  - KR2.2: Improve first-7-day retention for new API keys from 18% -> 28% for vector-search/embeddings flows
  - KR2.3: Ship 3 new quickstart templates (chat + search + reranker) and measure conversion lift

- OKR 3: Enterprise readiness and trust
  - KR3.1: Complete SOC2 readiness runway and pass external gap assessment
  - KR3.2: Ship VPC private control-plane GA checklist items (KMS integration, audit logging)
  - KR3.3: Close two Dedicated contract pilots (>=$X/month committed revenue)

Notes on these drafts: these are intentionally concise. Product/eng leads should expand KRs into measurable signals for their dashboards. We will finalize at Exec OKR sync on Mar 12.

Key signals & metrics to surface in all-hands (one-liners for slides):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 for hosted generation and embeddings (7d trend).
- Economics: per-1M-token unit cost estimate (hosted) and cost delta from Optimize recommendations.
body_continued:
- Adoption: weekly active API keys, signups -> production conversion rate.
- Reliability: uptime and error-rate incidents (SLO burn).
- Enterprise: # Dedicated pilots, GA milestones completed.

All-Hands run-of-show (60 minutes) - compact format:
- 00:00–00:05 Opening (CEO, 2 slides: state & priority) - clarity on 3 company bets
- 00:05–00:15 Product snapshot (Priya) - what customers will see this quarter; 3 quick demos (30s each)
- 00:15–00:25 Metrics pulse (Ops/Observability) - top signals (latency, cost, adoption, reliability)
- 00:25–00:35 Engineering highlight (Diego) - Dedicated autoscale beta + runtime optimizations
- 00:35–00:45 Customer & GTM spotlight (Lena) - pilot story + sales motion ask
- 00:45–00:55 Roadmap rhythms & team asks (cross-functional leads) - concrete team-level commitments
- 00:55–01:00 Close + 3 asks for everyone (what to do in the next 7 days)

Run logistics checklist (Week Zero):
- Slides: each exec gets 2 slides max. Deadline: Mar 6 EOD.
- Pre-read: 1-pager (this doc) + OKR summary. Publish to Confluence by Mar 7.
- Dry run schedule: Mar 11–12, 30m per presenter; sign up via calendar.
- Recording: yes. Short highlight clip (<3m) for public social/marketing.

Exec prep notes / talking points (working):
- CEO: emphasize trade-offs: speed vs cost; call out SLO priorities. Ask to teams: reduce friction for self-serve adoption.
- Product: concrete customer-facing promises this quarter (1–3 bullets). Call out any known risk of deferral.
- Eng: highlight the single most impactful runtime change and expected timeline. Avoid deep infra detail; focus on customer impact.
- SRE: show one incident trend and mitigation plan.

Team-level commitments template (what we expect from PM/ENG leads by Mar 10):
- 1-line sprint headline (what success looks like in 6 weeks)
- 3 measurable commits (metrics + owner)
- Blocking dependencies (who needs help)
- Risk level (low/med/high)

Communication plan (post-all-hands):
- T+0: send one-paragraph recap to all-staff with 3 bullets and 3 team-level tasks.
- T+1 day: Ops will publish detailed OKR doc + dashboard links.
- T+3 days: department syncs to convert company KRs -> team tasks.

Week-by-week timeline (compact):
- Week Zero (Mar 9-13): finalize slides, pre-reads, exec dry runs.
- All-Hands (Mar 16): company kickoff, publish OKRs.
- Week 1 (Mar 16-20): teams confirm sprint commitments; dashboard scaffolding.
- Week 2 (Mar 23-27): early experiments (Optimize, batching pilots); Dedicated onboarding prep.
- Week 3 (Mar 30-Apr 3): cadence: metrics checkpoint, first risk retro.

Risks & mitigations (bullet style):
- Risk: Slides late or inconsistent messaging -> Mitigation: strict slide template + one pager; ops enforces deadline and performs sync call if missing.
- Risk: Metrics not ready for all-hands -> Mitigation: show best-effort snapshot and commit to detailed dashboards within 48h.
- Risk: Execs diverge on prioritization -> Mitigation: pre-all-hands exec alignment meeting Mar 12 to resolve major conflicts.

Decisions needed by Mar 6 (list for execs):
- Confirm top-3 company bets to include in the all-hands.
- Approve template for OKR KRs (what counts as measurable).
- Sign off on pilot customer list for Dedicated autoscale beta.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Who will produce the 3-minute highlight clip? (marketing + comms) TODO: assign Lena.
- Confirm capacity for live demo (if network flakiness risk exists we should do recorded demo) - ask Eng to vet.
- Need a short customer quote for the GTM segment; PMs to pull by Mar 9.

Appendix A - Pre-read links and artifacts (short):
- One-pager OKR draft (link in linked_artifacts above).
- Latency & cost baseline spreadsheet: internal sheet (sheet id: SHEET-ops-latency-2026).
- Dedicated pilots tracker: JIRA-DEDICATED-001.

Appendix B - Micro-template for slides (copy into deck):
- Slide 1: Title + 1-line headline (what we expect to accomplish this quarter).
- Slide 2: 3 bullets: 1) customer impact, 2) measurable outcome, 3) one ask of the company.

Notes to organizers (final):
- Keep it compact. People are overloaded; clarity > completeness.
- This doc is the single source for Week Zero logistics. Any changes: update last_modified and ping #all-hands-week-zero.
